text:
Anika (PM): Quick sync — carving the 'lane orchestra' scope for Q2. Need cross-team alignment on launch criteria, sequencing, and the minimum prod-ready surface for the pilot. MVP: hosted API + dedicated pilot pools. Private (VPC) deferred to v1. Who owns prewarm/capacity and security gating?
Ravi (Eng Runtime): I can own runtime batching, KV cache behavior, and quantization profiles. Need clear SLO targets and perf harness inputs.
Anika (PM): Targets: p50 <= 80ms for short prompts; p95 <= 250ms for typical flows (<=512 tokens). Also define cost budget per 1k requests for pilot. Marta — can we reserve capacity?
Marta (Product Ops): We can reserve two pilot pools (small, medium). Need a 7-day forecast by EOD Tue to lock slots and billing. I'll open a capacity ticket.
Lena (Infra): Infra can provision pilot pools in us-east1 and eu-west1. We'll need IaC for prewarm policy and acceptance tests. Region pinning confirmed for pilot.
Carlos (Security): Security checklist: CMEK (customer-managed keys) + audit log stream + SSO/SCIM mapping. Also confirm data retention — are we storing prompts?
Anika (PM): Customer requests no prompt retention. CMEK required for production; for pilot we can accept Redwood-managed KMS if customer can't provide keys immediately, but security signoff still required before canary.
Ravi (Eng Runtime): For rollout we want canary 5% org traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to a lower-memory model variant if tail latency spikes. I'll validate fallback paths and model-compatibility.
Marta (Product Ops): Created ticket CAP-4526 for pilot capacity forecasting. Assigning to @Lena and @Ravi for infra/perf inputs. Preferred rollout windows: Tue/Thu mornings PT for lower traffic.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: CAP-4526 assigned to Lena, Ravi. CI pipeline queued.
Carlos (Security): Blocking item: for private/on-prem, KMS keys must live in the customer's project. If they can't supply keys before pilot, we need an exception for non-prod using Redwood-managed KMS. Need decision from Anika.
Anika (PM): I'll confirm with the customer today. If keys unavailable, fall back to Redwood-managed KMS for pilot only; production requires customer CMEK signoff.
Ravi (Eng Runtime): Action items (short): 1) perf matrix + quant profiles (Ravi) 2) prewarm policy + IaC (Lena) 3) security deliverables + threat model (Carlos) 4) capacity forecast (Marta) 5) canary runbook + rollback criteria (Anika). I will PR the perf harness by EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Product Ops): Scheduling a 30-min runbook rehearsal Wed 10:00am PT. Calendar invite sent to Anika, Ravi, Lena, Carlos.
Lena (Infra): Note: autoscaler needs a soft-start to avoid thundering prewarm. We'll include token-rate thresholds and a warmup buffer in the IaC. Also include a per-region capacity cap for pilot.
Anika (PM): :thumbsup: I'll consolidate deliverables into the launch checklist and post a follow-up plan. If no new blockers by Fri EOD, target pilot next Tue morning (canary -> ramp).
Ravi (Eng Runtime): :ok_hand: I'll post perf artifacts (latency histograms, cost estimates, quant tradeoffs) in this thread when the PR merges.
Carlos (Security): I'll draft a minimal threat model and a short checklist for CMEK and audit streams. Expect doc by Tue morning.
Marta (Product Ops): Quick note — customer success will need a one-pager for the pilot availability, SLA expectations, and rollback plan. I'll draft and share.
Anika (PM): Thanks everyone. If you hit any blocker, @channel call it out here. We'll reconvene if security/KMS becomes sticky.
